task.title: Set up the brewer
task.shortdesc: Get the Acme Brewer ready for its first pot.

taskbody.prereq: Place the brewer on a flat surface near a power outlet.

step.cmd: Rinse the carafe and filter basket with warm water.
Fill the tank to the MAX line with cold water.
Plug in the brewer and press Brew without coffee.
step.info: This first cycle flushes the system.

step.cmd: Pour out the water when the cycle ends.

taskbody.result: The brewer is ready to make coffee.
